narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Exposition -> Behind-the-scenes Reveal -> Narrative Example -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional behind-the-scenes look at the variety show 'Doctor Is So Hot' (醫師好辣). It uses a humorous hook involving physical comedy (hitting a foot) to grab attention, then transitions into the main creator sharing his experience on the show. It interestingly reveals the artifice of TV production by showing how 'reaction shots' are pre-recorded, and concludes by inviting viewers to watch the full episode.
